name: tabs-plant-missing
summary: Switches between panels in one place, across or down: the selected tab marked by UI SDK's sliding indicator, an edge that slides to the tab chosen, and a disabled tab that takes focus but is never selected.

notCovered.name: the indicator with no script
notCovered.why: UI SDK places the indicator by measuring the selected tab at run time, so with no script it has no box, and the selected tab shows by its words alone.
